system.description: A clandestine leader with a direct channel to Dark Powers.
system.notes:
Normal | Leader

A clandestine leader with a direct channel to Dark Powers.
Motives & Tactics: Amass power, plot, take command

Difficulty: 12 | Thresholds: 6/12 | HP: 6 | Stress: 3

ATK: +3 | Magic: Far | 1d12+1 phy

Experience: Coercion +2, Fallen Lore +2

Features

Seize The Moment - Action: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

Our Master’s Will - Reaction: When you spotlight an ally within Far range, mark a Stress to gain a Fear.

Summoning Ritual - Reaction: Countdown (6). The first time the Leader is spotlighted, activate the countdown. Whenever the Leader marks HP, tick the countdown up by that amount. When it triggers, summon a Demon at Close range.

Zombies - Reaction: Once per scene, when the Leader marks 2 or more HP, you can mark a Stress to summon a Zombie Pack at Close range and immediately spotlight it.
